description: Standardized network-flow benchmark for EV charging network anomaly detection and multi-model comparison.

feature_descriptions.packet_rate: Number of packets transferred per second (pkt/s)
feature_descriptions.new_connection_rate: Rate of newly created TCP connections per second (conn/s)
feature_descriptions.active_connections: Current concurrent open active connections count
feature_descriptions.data_transfer_volume: Total volume of data transferred per second in bytes (B/s)
feature_descriptions.connection_duration: Average latency or connection hold time in milliseconds (ms)
